_about: Every floor's main line and side quests. Generated by tools/build_quest_lines.mjs; see scripts/story/quest_lines.gd.

stairs.how: Four padlocks on the stairwell chain. Pylon has one key, Lost Property has one, the Moth Matron swallowed one, and the fourth lock eats validated tickets. Marta knows the rest.
stairs.locked: Chained. Four padlocks, four different shapes.

f1_lay.name: Lay of the Land
f1_lay.desc: Marta wants you to know the ground before you try anything stupid. Climb high, find the hideout, read the shrine.

steps.say: read the names scratched into the shrine
steps.label: Read the names on the Shrine
steps.text: Hundreds of names. Some of the dates are from before Earth was taken.

the_stairs.name: The Chained Stairwell
the_stairs.desc: Four padlocks on the stairwell chain. Pylon has one key. Lost Property has another. The Moth Matron swallowed the third. The fourth lock takes a validated parking ticket.

f1_key_toll.name: The Toll Key
f1_key_toll.desc: Pylon wears the first key on a lanyard and charges a toll to look at it.

steps.label: Break the toll line: 8 Traffic-Cone Goblins
Deal with Sergeant Pylon: kill him, or a truce through Pickles

f1_key_lost.name: Lost Property
f1_key_lost.desc: Somebody handed the second key in. Lost Property has it now, and Lost Property does not give things back.

steps.label: Find the claim ticket in the Burning Bus
steps.text: A claim ticket, half melted: ITEM: KEY, STAIRWELL (1). COLLECT FROM LOST PROPERTY.

steps.label: Take the ticket to the Lost Property Office
Take the key from Lost & Found in its throne room

f1_key_moth.name: Moth in the Lock
f1_key_moth.desc: The Moth Matron swallowed the third key, because it was shiny. The Lamplighters want her burned. You just want the key.

steps.label: Ask the Lamplighters about the Matron
Cut the key out of her cocoon
steps.text: Wrapped in silk like a present: a small brass key.

f1_key_ticket.name: The Ticket Lock
f1_key_ticket.desc: The fourth padlock has a slot where the keyhole should be. It wants a ticket, validated.

steps.label: Solve the ticket machine near the Exit Sign

steps.say: feed the ticket into the fourth lock
steps.label: Feed the validated ticket into the lock
steps.text: The lock eats the ticket, thinks about it, and clicks open.

f1_finders.name: Finders Keepers
f1_finders.desc: The Vasquez Twins "found" some contestants' Welcome Box loot. Get it back.

steps.label: Take the kit back
steps.text: One of the twins grins: "We'll owe you one. Maybe."

f1_pigeons.name: The Pigeon Problem
f1_pigeons.desc: The Pigeon Loft's birds have been stealing food from the camp.

stairs.how: The stairs were bricked up seasons ago. The way down is the Great Dryer: it needs boiler pressure, the right cycle, and Ebb off shift.
stairs.locked: ERROR: INSUFFICIENT PRESSURE. NO CYCLE SELECTED. CUSTODIAN ON SHIFT.

exit.text: Press E: climb into the Great Dryer
exit.old: Bricked up, with a sign: "STAIRS CLOSED FOR CLEANING SINCE 1986."

f2_customer.name: Customer Service
f2_customer.desc: WELCOME TO CUSTOMER SERVICE. The doors lock behind you, and the big screen starts counting.

steps.label: Read the load screen
steps.text: CURRENT LOAD: 4,117,021 CONTESTANTS. Nobody knows what "processing" means.

steps.label: Try the Dryer
steps.text: ERROR: INSUFFICIENT PRESSURE. ERROR: NO CYCLE SELECTED. ERROR: CUSTODIAN ON SHIFT.

f2_pressure.name: Building Pressure
f2_pressure.desc: Three pressure valves feed the Dryer from the boiler. The Mop Wights keep closing them, because that's their job.

steps.label: Stop the Mop Wights closing them again: 10 wights

f2_cycle.name: Delicates
f2_cycle.desc: The Dryer has eighteen symbols. The right cycle is sewn into laundry tags all over the floor, one symbol each.

steps.label: Find a symbol tag in Sock Mountain

steps.say: fish a shirt out of the falls
steps.label: Find a symbol tag at Soap Falls

steps.say: pull a tag out of the lint
steps.label: Find a symbol tag in the Lint Traps
Find a symbol tag in the Machine Graveyard
Find a symbol tag at the Survivor Hideout
Dial the cycle into the Dryer
steps.text: DESTINATION: FLOOR 18. ERROR: FLOOR 18 DOES NOT EXIST. The Host's voice cuts in: "Oops! Let's not play with the old machinery." The dial resets to FLOOR 3.

f2_shift.name: Off Shift
f2_shift.desc: The Dryer won't run while a custodian is on shift. Head Custodian Ebb has been on shift for forty years.

steps.label: Find Reggie's timecard in Boiler Room 0 (talk to Old Reggie)
Take Head Custodian Ebb off shift

f2_final.name: Final Spin
f2_final.desc: Pressure up, cycle set, nobody on shift. Climb in. The Mop Wights know what you're doing and they don't like it.

f2_dave.name: The Machine That Ate Dave
f2_dave.desc: Spin Cycle says Dave's been eaten again. Nobody is worried, because it keeps happening.

steps.label: Help Dave climb out
steps.text: "Oh. You're new." He brushes himself off. "Don't trust the dryers."

f2_lint.name: Lint Rights
f2_lint.desc: The Lint King says every bit of lint on the floor is his.

steps.label: Settle it with the Lint King

f2_sheets.name: Shapes Behind the Sheets
f2_sheets.desc: Most of the shapes in the drying yards are laundry.

steps.label: Look behind the sheets near the Mop Graves
Deal with the ones that aren't laundry: 6 wights

stairs.how: The stairs are under the Cone King's throne, and the Cone Cathedral only opens for invited guests. Get invitations from Grandma Gristle, the Bulb Queen and Old Man Coo.
stairs.locked: The Cathedral doors are shut. A cone with a slot says: INVITATIONS ONLY.

f3_bell.name: The Dinner Bell
f3_bell.desc: "Dinner Bell's in twenty minutes." Everyone goes quiet when you ask what that means.

steps.label: Find out what the Dinner Bell is

steps.say: eat a bowl when the bell rings
steps.label: Eat when the Bell rings
steps.text: You feel full, warm, and very slightly different.

f3_calling.name: A Calling
f3_calling.desc: Registrar Odessa: every contestant who reaches Floor 3 chooses what they are. Then they prove it.

steps.label: Go to the Hall of Callings shrine

f3_guest.name: Guest of the Cone
f3_guest.desc: The Cone King feasts once a season and only invited guests come in. Three powers in the district can invite you.

steps.label: An invitation from the Bulb Queen's court
An invitation from Old Man Coo

f3_inv_gristle.name: Grandma's Table
f3_inv_gristle.desc: Gristle will invite anyone who clears the hags out of her pantry. She will also try to cook them.

steps.say: take the invitation from under the sugar bowl
steps.label: Take her invitation
steps.text: In Gristle's handwriting: "One guest. Bring your own bowl." There's a recipe on the back. It's called CONTESTANT.

f3_inv_queen.name: Light the Market
f3_inv_queen.desc: The Bulb Queen's court is starving for light. Relight the market and the court will vouch for you.

f3_inv_coo.name: Up on the Roof
f3_inv_coo.desc: Old Man Coo has an invitation he's never used. He'll trade it, if you can get up to him.

steps.label: Get past the roost: 10 Pigeon Ghouls

steps.say: trade Coo a crust for his invitation
steps.label: Trade with Old Man Coo
steps.text: "They went sideways, you know. Not down. Sideways." He won't say more.

f3_feast.name: The Feast of Cones
f3_feast.desc: Three invitations. The Cathedral opens. The Cone King has set a place for you, and he would like you to sit in it forever.

steps.label: Attend the feast at the Cone Cathedral
Survive the honour guard: 4 Cone Captains
Face the Cone King at his own table

f3_broth.name: The First Broth
f3_broth.desc: Both feuding soups come from one recipe gone wrong. The recipe was carved on tablets.

steps.label: Find a recipe tablet at the Scratch Marks
Find a recipe tablet at the Stewpot
Find a recipe tablet at the Survivor Hideout
Cook the First Broth
steps.text: It isn't soup. It moves. It was never food: it was used to make life.

f3_sideways.name: Sideways
f3_sideways.desc: Old Man Coo says contestants used to go sideways, not down. There's a sealed hatch at the top of the city.

steps.label: Climb the hill above Soup Row
Find the sealed hatch
steps.text: A hatch with the Builders' mark, welded shut from this side.

stairs.how: The service lift is the only way out of the Mall. It needs a staff badge, three fuses, and someone to get past the Food Court Kraken before the shutters come down.
stairs.locked: STAFF ONLY. Badge reader dark. Fuse box empty.

f4_directory.name: You Are Here
f4_directory.desc: Every map in the Mall says YOU ARE HERE, and every arrow points to the Atrium.

steps.label: Read the directory
steps.text: YOU ARE HERE. EXIT: STAFF ONLY. Someone has scratched "NO EXIT" over it.

steps.label: Ride the Escalator to Nowhere and come back

f4_badge.name: Staff Only
f4_badge.desc: Mall Security issues staff badges. Mall Security does not issue them to you.

f4_fuses.name: Blown
f4_fuses.desc: The lift's three fuses were pulled and hidden around the Mall. The Mall wants you to stay.

steps.say: pull a fuse from the wreck
steps.label: Find the fuse in the Wreck
Find the fuse in the Hidden Cache
Find the fuse in the Nest

f4_veins.name: The Veins
f4_veins.desc: Something under the tiles is pulsing. Follow it, and find out who's keeping everyone here.

steps.label: Follow the veins to the Atrium

steps.say: put your hand on the wall
steps.label: Touch the heart of the Mall
steps.text: It's warm. It's beating. A voice like a lullaby: "Stay, sweetheart. Everything you need is here." The shutters start to come down.

f4_closing.name: Closing Time
f4_closing.desc: The Mall Mother has called closing time. Every shutter is coming down. Get to the lift.

steps.label: Get to the Food Court Depths
Get past the Food Court Kraken

steps.say: swipe the badge and fit the fuses
steps.label: Start the service lift

timer.label: CLOSING TIME
timer.fail: The shutters slam down. You wake up in the Food Court Free State, tucked into a sleeping bag that smells of cinnamon. Over the tannoy, the Mall Mother says goodnight. The Mall opens again whenever you're ready.

f4_timmy.name: Finders, Keepers
f4_timmy.desc: Timmy, the lost child, is hiding from the Mall. He's been seen near the Changing Rooms.

steps.label: Ask at the Survivor Hideout
steps.text: Timmy's here. He's been here six seasons.

f4_notice.name: Final Notice
f4_notice.desc: The Coupon Den's coupons are debts, and one of them is yours.

f4_party.name: Birthday Party
f4_party.desc: The Bounce Castle is having a party. It has been having it for nine years.

stairs.how: The manhole is inside the HOA Clubhouse grounds and needs a stamped Permit to Descend: three signatures, no unpaid fines, and the HOA's vote.
stairs.locked: A padlocked manhole with a sign: PERMIT HOLDERS ONLY. FORM 27B.

f5_fined.name: Notice of Violation
f5_fined.desc: You've been here thirty seconds and you've already been fined.

steps.say: read the fine stuck to your back
steps.label: Read your first fine
steps.text: NOTICE OF VIOLATION #1: ARRIVING. NOTICE #2: STANDING. NOTICE #3: READING THIS.

steps.label: Go to the Block Party and ask how anyone leaves

f5_signatures.name: Three Signatures
f5_signatures.desc: Form 27B needs three neighbours to sign it. None of them want you to leave.

steps.label: A signature from the Survivor Hideout
A signature at the Block Party
Calm the Dog Park: 6 Cul-de-Sac Hounds

f5_fines.name: Paid in Full
f5_fines.desc: The gnomes collect fines for the HOA. Your fines. Take them back.

steps.label: Take your fines back: 12 Lawn Gnome Cultists
The Gnome Pope has blessed the rest. Un-bless him.

f5_meeting.name: The HOA Meeting
f5_meeting.desc: Every permit goes to a vote. The HOA President has never lost one.

steps.label: Win the vote: depose the HOA President
Get the permit stamped at Town Hall
steps.text: Mayor Eternal stamps it without looking up. "Re-elect me," he says, to no one.

f5_hendersons.name: The Hendersons
f5_hendersons.desc: The same family waves from every yard on the street.

steps.label: Watch the street from the hill
Find the Hendersons' real house
steps.text: Photos on the wall: the Hendersons as contestants, three seasons ago. They settled down.

f5_gnomes.name: Gnome Rights
f5_gnomes.desc: The garden gnomes want out of the gardens.

f5_mayor.name: Re-Elect Nobody
f5_mayor.desc: Mayor Eternal has won every election since the Stack began.

stairs.how: The stairs are at the Glimmerkin Safari Lodge, and the Lodge only lets hunters through. Become one, then survive Hunt Night.
stairs.locked: The Lodge gate: MEMBERS AND THEIR TROPHIES ONLY.

f6_prey.name: Prey
f6_prey.desc: Somebody has paid to hunt you. Get under cover before dark.

steps.label: Learn to hide your scent
steps.text: The hunters lose your trail. For now.

f6_trophies.name: Turn the Tables
f6_trophies.desc: The Lodge wants trophies. Bring them some of its own.

steps.label: Steal the hunters' ledger
steps.text: Payment column: ATTENTION. Thousands of hours of it, for every kill.

f6_licence.name: Licensed
f6_licence.desc: You need a hunter's licence to sign the guestbook. The Wild Kennel's Matriarch wears one on her collar.

steps.label: Take the licence from the Dog Park Matriarch

f6_guestbook.name: Sign the Guestbook
f6_guestbook.desc: Members sign the guestbook in the Great Lodge. Members are allowed in for Hunt Night.

steps.label: Watch the Lodge from the Hunters' Hide
Sign the guestbook as a hunter
steps.text: Every name above yours is an audience member. Some of them are famous on Earth.

f6_hunt.name: Hunt Night
f6_hunt.desc: Hunt Night starts at the Tallest Tree. This time the quarry is Lord-Hunter Facet.

steps.label: Start the hunt at the Tallest Tree

f6_bridges.name: Rope Bridges
f6_bridges.desc: Tank, a huge contestant who's terrified of heights, is stuck halfway across the canopy.

steps.label: Find Tank at the Hunters' Hide
Get Tank across the bridges
steps.text: "I've got you." He doesn't let go of your arm for a full minute.

f6_sludge.name: Hag Hollow
f6_sludge.desc: Auntie Sludge sells scent masks. Her price is your company, forever.

steps.label: Get out of Auntie Sludge's deal

f6_roots.name: Under the Roots
f6_roots.desc: The Tallest Tree's roots go somewhere that isn't down.

steps.label: Find the sealed root door
steps.text: A door in the roots with a cone-shaped keyhole. Pickles' key would fit.

stairs.how: The stairs are under ten metres of water. Get the sluice crank from the Rent Tribunal, open the sluices, and the Sanitation King will try to stop the water going anywhere.
stairs.locked: Water. Just water, all the way down.

f7_rent.name: Rent Is Due
f7_rent.desc: You arrived owing three weeks. Nobody remembers lending you anything.

steps.label: Read your tenancy agreement
steps.text: ARREARS: 3 WEEKS. INTEREST: YES.

f7_crank.name: The Crank
f7_crank.desc: The sluice crank was "repossessed" years ago. It's in the Tribunal's evidence locker.

steps.label: Bring it to the Sluice Gate

f7_sluices.name: Low Tide
f7_sluices.desc: Three sluices drain the Cistern. Open them in order, and everything that lives in the water comes up to see why.

steps.label: Survive what comes up: 12 Sewer Wyrms

timer.label: FLOOD TIDE
timer.fail: The water comes back up through the grates faster than you can run. The sluices slam shut, one after another. Start again from the first.

f7_barge.name: Barge Day
f7_barge.desc: The water's going down. The Sanitation King's barge is blocking the outfall to keep it in.

steps.label: Find the stairs under the water line

f7_ferry.name: The Free Ferry
f7_ferry.desc: Nan Gangway has ferried people for free for three seasons. Something keeps attacking the ferry.

f7_bath.name: Bathwater
f7_bath.desc: Old Lady Bathwater's baths never drain.

steps.label: Pull the plug on Old Lady Bathwater

f7_organ.name: The Organ Loft
f7_organ.desc: The Pipe Organ Wyrm only sleeps when the right tune is played.

steps.label: Find the sheet music in the Drowned Cathedral
Bring it to the Organ Loft

f7_outfall.name: Down the Drain
f7_outfall.desc: A priest of Old Damp preaches at the Great Outfall. His congregation is mostly drowned.

stairs.how: There are no stairs on the Workings. You dig. You need a drill bit, fuel and track, and Big Momma Mold is sitting on the only seam soft enough to drill.
stairs.locked: The old shaft is full of rock.

exit.text: Press E: drill down through the Bright Seam
exit.old: The old shaft. Full of rock to the brim.

f8_count.name: Twelve Came Up
f8_count.desc: Eleven miners went down. Twelve came up. Foreman Tuck wants you to count them.

steps.label: Find the miners at the Survivor Hideout
Count the tags on the Shrine
steps.text: Eleven tags. The twelfth miner doesn't have one, and doesn't blink.

f8_bit.name: The Bit
f8_bit.desc: The Drill Prophet keeps the last good drill bit on his altar. He thinks it talks to him.

steps.label: Take the bit from the Drill Prophet

f8_fuel.name: Fuel
f8_fuel.desc: The drill burns fryer grease. The Fryer Baron has a manor full of it.

f8_track.name: Track
f8_track.desc: Chief Grubtooth's mole-kin pulled up every rail on the floor to build his throne.

steps.label: Take back the track from Chief Grubtooth

f8_dig.name: Dig
f8_dig.desc: Bit, fuel, track. The only seam soft enough to drill is under the Nursery, where Big Momma Mold tells everyone they've done enough.

steps.label: Set up the drill on the Bright Seam

f8_pocket.name: Pocket
f8_pocket.desc: A tiny, cheerful contestant called Pocket is being eaten by mould somewhere near the Nursery.

steps.say: pull Pocket out of the spores
steps.label: Find Pocket in the spores
steps.text: "Hi! I'm mostly fine!" She is not mostly fine.

steps.label: Carry her to the Survivor Hideout

f8_repo.name: Repo Day
f8_repo.desc: Repossessor Mk. IX is repossessing contestants' gear.

f8_canary.name: Canary's Song
f8_canary.desc: A canary in the Shaft sings the same five notes over and over.

steps.label: Learn the canary's song
steps.text: Five notes. Someone tells you it's a password, for a door you haven't found.

stairs.how: Only the Undermayor can open the stairs, and the Undermayor has never been elected. Win the vote, then make him concede.
stairs.locked: BY ORDER OF THE UNDERMAYOR: CLOSED.

f9_register.name: Register
f9_register.desc: Everyone votes in the Undercity. Non-voters are "redistributed".

steps.label: Register in Verdigris Square
steps.text: Your ballot number is very long. Sister Verdigris says you'll need three districts to win.

f9_campaign.name: The Campaign
f9_campaign.desc: Three districts decide everything. Win them by speeches, favours, or ballot boxes.

f9_v_senate.name: The Senate Votes
f9_v_senate.desc: Thirty rats, one vote, endless amendments.

f9_v_opera.name: A Song for the People
f9_v_opera.desc: The Opera House votes however the Soloist sings. She's been holding one note for decades.

steps.label: Find her lost score at the Exchange
Bring it to the Opera House

f9_v_throne.name: Kneel
f9_v_throne.desc: The Rat Throne King votes the whole east side. He votes for whoever kneels.

f9_count.name: The Count
f9_count.desc: You won. The Undermayor has locked the ballots in the Vault and refuses to concede.

steps.label: Demand a recount at the Capitol
Break the ballots out of the Vault
Unseat the Undermayor at City Hall

f9_lantern.name: What Burns
f9_lantern.desc: Something alive burns in the Founders Lantern.

steps.label: Look inside
steps.text: A Builder relic, still alive, burning so the city has light.

f9_mags.name: Mags' Old Crew
f9_mags.desc: Mags' old crew has been in the Vault for decades.

stairs.how: You're in an episode now. Shoot all three scenes, then wrap the Showrunner. The stairs are behind the last set.
stairs.locked: CLOSED SET. A sign: NOT UNTIL THE EPISODE WRAPS.

f10_call.name: Call Sheet
f10_call.desc: A runner hands you a call sheet with your name on it. You're the guest star. The episode is called "Down And Out".

steps.label: Read the call sheet
steps.text: SCENE 1: HIGH NOON. SCENE 2: MOON LANDING. SCENE 3: FINAL LOOK. GUEST STAR DIES IN ACT 3 (TBC).

f10_s1.name: Scene 1: High Noon
f10_s1.desc: A showdown on the Western Set. The Stunt Double has played your death before.

f10_s2.name: Scene 2: Moon Landing
f10_s2.desc: Plant a flag on the Fake Moon while the crew throws everything at you for "texture".

f10_s3.name: Scene 3: Final Look
f10_s3.desc: Hair and makeup for the final scene. The Makeup Witch does faces. Permanently.

steps.label: Get out of the Makeup Witch's chair

f10_wrap.name: That's a Wrap
f10_wrap.desc: Three scenes in the can. The Showrunner wants a different ending, with you in a body bag.

f10_dex.name: Dex's Episode
f10_dex.desc: Dex is shooting his episode next to yours and needs a villain.

f10_glutton.name: Catering
f10_glutton.desc: The Craft Services Glutton has eaten the crew's lunch, and the crew.

f10_manager.name: Places, Please
f10_manager.desc: The Floor Manager wants everyone in position, permanently.

stairs.how: Ratings Week. The stairs open for the tournament winner, nobody else. Win five rounds.

f11_entry.name: Sign Up
f11_entry.desc: Every contestant on Floor 11 is entered in Ratings Week. Declining is not an option on the form.

steps.label: Sign the tournament sheet
steps.text: Your seed: 64th of 64. The odds on you are very long.

f11_r1.name: Round 1: The Mascots
f11_r1.desc: An easy opener against the Mascot Pen. The crowd loves a mascot fight.

f11_r2.name: Round 2: The Squad
f11_r2.desc: The Cheer Squad fights in formation.

f11_r3.name: Round 3: The Away End
f11_r3.desc: The Ultras have never lost at home, because they kill the away team.

f11_semi.name: Semi-Final: The Ref
f11_semi.desc: The Ref is your semi-final opponent. He is also refereeing it.

steps.label: Beat the Ref, fair or otherwise

f11_final.name: The Final
f11_final.desc: Last season's winner, kept alive for exactly this. He whispers "Don't win" as you walk out.

f11_jojo.name: Halftime
f11_jojo.desc: Jojo Spark is booked as the Halftime Show. Encore wants her for good.

steps.label: Talk Jojo off the stage
steps.text: "They'd have loved it," she says. "They'd have loved me." She comes with you anyway.

f11_trophy.name: The Trophy Cabinet
f11_trophy.desc: Every past winner's trophy is in the cabinet. One is missing.

steps.label: Look at the empty plinth
steps.text: The label reads SEASON ONE. The trophy is on Floor 17.

stairs.how: The way down is a trapdoor on the talk show set, and only guests get on set. Get an agent, get famous, get booked, then refuse the Producer.

f12_agent.name: Representation
f12_agent.desc: Nobody gets booked without an agent. Agent Twelve Percent takes twelve percent of everything, including organs.

steps.label: Get Agent Twelve Percent to sign you (or take his contacts)

f12_buzz.name: Buzz
f12_buzz.desc: You need to be in the papers. The paparazzi will make you famous if you make it worth their while.

f12_laugh.name: Warm-Up
f12_laugh.desc: The Laugh Track decides whether you're funny. Get it on your side.

steps.label: Go to the Laugh Track Factory

f12_show.name: Tonight's Guest
f12_show.desc: You're booked on Jolly Jack Brightly. The couch is very comfortable. There's a trapdoor under it.

steps.label: Find the trapdoor under the Big Couch
steps.text: A trapdoor with a combination lock. The combination is in the Producer's office.

f12_contract.name: The Contract
f12_contract.desc: The Producer offers you a recurring role. Forever. He doesn't take no.

steps.label: Take the meeting on the Producers' Floor

f12_canned.name: Canned
f12_canned.desc: Every laugh in the Laugh Track Factory is a contestant.

f12_ghost.name: The Ghostwriter
f12_ghost.desc: The Writers' Pit has your ending already written.

steps.label: Steal the script
steps.text: The last page has three endings. Two are crossed out.

stairs.how: The Archivist keeps the stairs key in the Restricted Section. Follow your own catalogue entry to find out how to get in. Quietly.
stairs.locked: SILENCE. RESTRICTED. KEY HELD BY THE ARCHIVIST.

f13_card.name: Look Yourself Up
f13_card.desc: There's a catalogue card with your name on it.

steps.label: Find your card in the Catalogue Spire
steps.text: YOUR NAME. SEE ALSO: LOST & FOUND OF BOOKS.

f13_lost.name: See Also
f13_lost.desc: Your card points somewhere else. They all do.

steps.label: Search the Lost & Found of Books
steps.text: A book with your name on the spine. Chapter one is your arrival. The last chapter is blank. A note: CONTINUED ON THE TOP SHELF.

f13_ladder.name: The Top Shelf
f13_ladder.desc: The top shelf is at the top of the Endless Ladder. It does end. Eventually.

steps.label: Get past 8 Bookwyrms on the way up

steps.say: take the volume from the top shelf
steps.label: Take the second volume
steps.text: The last page: RESTRICTED. ACCESS BY INDEX PASS.

f13_pass.name: Index Pass
f13_pass.desc: The Index Clerk issues passes. He has issued none since the first season.

f13_key.name: The Only Key
f13_key.desc: The Restricted Section. The Archivist has been waiting for your book to reach this chapter.

steps.label: Get the key from the Archivist

f13_overdue.name: Overdue
f13_overdue.desc: Everything returned down the chute comes back wrong.

f13_bindery.name: The Bindery
f13_bindery.desc: The Bindery Foreman binds anything. Anyone.

f13_reading.name: Silence
f13_reading.desc: The Head Librarian's Reading Room has a strict silence rule. Breaking it is fatal.

stairs.how: Castle Dread runs Season Nine's script, five acts, every night. The way down is beneath the Keep, after the final act.
stairs.locked: The crypt stairs are bricked over: "INTERMISSION."

f14_a1.name: Act I: The Stranger at the Inn
f14_a1.desc: The innkeeper hands you a script. You're playing the stranger who arrives on a stormy night.

steps.label: Take the script
steps.text: ACT I: THE STRANGER VISITS THE GRAVEYARD AT MIDNIGHT. HE DOES NOT COME BACK THE SAME.

f14_a2.name: Act II: The Gate
f14_a2.desc: The drawbridge only drops for whoever beats the Portcullis Knight.

f14_a3.name: Act III: The Witch on the Crag
f14_a3.desc: The script calls for a visit to the Wax Witch, who has the castle's second key in a candle.

f14_a4.name: Act IV: Below
f14_a4.desc: The crypts under the castle connect to everything. The Ossuary conducts the Bone Choir down there.

f14_a5.name: Act V: The Count
f14_a5.desc: The final act. The Count has played it every night for decades and never once lost.

steps.label: Give the Count his final curtain

f14_portrait.name: Marta's Portrait
f14_portrait.desc: The portrait gallery has a painting of a maid from Season Nine. She looks like Marta.

steps.label: Find the portrait
steps.text: Marta, decades younger, in a maid's uniform. Signed "Season 9".

f14_graves.name: Headstones
f14_graves.desc: The graveyard is full of past contestants.

steps.label: Read the headstones
steps.text: Names, seasons and the floor they died on. You recognise some from the Floor 1 shrine.

stairs.how: The Recorder in the Core opens the stairs once it has played its message. The message is in four pieces, and the cold kills anyone who takes too long.

f15_warm.name: Warm Room
f15_warm.desc: Out here, the cold kills you slowly. The Warm Room's heater is the only safe place.

steps.say: warm your hands at the heater
steps.label: Warm up in the Warm Room
Find out what the Blinking Light is
steps.text: It blinks four times, waits, then four again. Something is waiting for four pieces.

f15_tapes.name: The Message
f15_tapes.desc: The Builders' last message was cut into four tapes and filed in four different places.

steps.label: Recover tape one from the Tape Library

steps.say: pull the tape from the cables
steps.label: Recover tape two from the Cable Jungle
Recover tape three from the Cooling Towers

steps.say: chip the tape out of the ice
steps.label: Recover tape four from the Frozen Server

f15_firewall.name: Access Denied
f15_firewall.desc: The Firewall won't let the tapes through to the Core.

f15_core.name: Playback
f15_core.desc: The Recorder has been waiting to play this for a very long time.

f15_rattle.name: Rattle Remembers
f15_rattle.desc: Rattle, the robot contestant, doesn't remember being human.

steps.label: Find Rattle's backup tape
steps.text: Season 4. A woman's voice. "If anyone finds this, my name was..." The rest is static.

steps.label: Press it
steps.text: Every light on the floor goes out. A voice: "Why would you do that." Every monster on the floor now knows where you are.

f15_cable.name: Cable Mother
f15_cable.desc: The Cable Mother is strangling the Warm Room's power line.

hazard.label: WARMTH
hazard.warn: Your fingers have stopped working. Find heat: the Warm Room, or a fire at a hideout, lookout, shrine or summit.

stairs.how: The Director holds the Gallery, and the Gallery holds the way down. The off-air engineer has a plan: ten seconds of dead air.

f16_crew.name: The Crew
f16_crew.desc: An engineer in the Canteen says she can take the whole broadcast down for ten seconds. She needs people who don't mind being off camera.

steps.label: Meet the off-air engineer
steps.text: "Ten seconds of dead air. That's all you get. Make them count."

f16_plan.name: Casing the Job
f16_plan.desc: Learn the schedule, scout the dead zone, steal the keys.

steps.label: Steal the tower schedule from the Big Mast

f16_towers.name: Lights Out
f16_towers.desc: The Dish Array would reroute the signal around the dead air. Take it down first.

f16_heist.name: Dead Air
f16_heist.desc: The dead air will not last. Kill the Live Light, then run for the Gallery before it comes back on.

steps.label: Kill the Live Light
steps.text: TEN SECONDS OF DEAD AIR. Somewhere, every screen on Earth goes black.

steps.label: Take the Gallery from the Director

timer.label: DEAD AIR
timer.fail: The Live Light flickers back on. ON AIR. Every camera on the floor swings round to look at you. Kill the light again.

f16_dex.name: Dex's Choice
f16_dex.desc: Dex has found out what fans are.

steps.label: Tell him the truth
steps.text: He goes very quiet. "So every one of them..." He turns off his camera.

f16_feed.name: Ratings
f16_feed.desc: Your number, live, in the Ratings Room.

f16_prompt.name: Your Lines
f16_prompt.desc: The Teleprompter has your lines for the rest of your life.

stairs.how: The Host is in the Studio, and the Studio only opens once you've played through his episodes.
stairs.locked: A sign on the Studio door: TAPING. PLEASE WAIT FOR THE LAUGH.

f17_e1.name: Episode 1: Welcome Home
f17_e1.desc: Main Street, fifty years ago. Everyone knows your name. There's a laugh track.

steps.label: Sit down for family dinner
steps.text: Everyone at the table has the Host's face, at different ages. *laughter*

f17_e2.name: Episode 2: The Big Game
f17_e2.desc: The whole town is at the game. The Fan Club President is very, very excited to meet you.

f17_e3.name: Episode 3: Mirror, Mirror
f17_e3.desc: In the Mirror Maze someone has your face and is doing your lines better than you.

f17_reel.name: Behind the Scenes
f17_reel.desc: The drive-in is showing old footage nobody was meant to see.

steps.label: Watch the old reel at the Drive-In
steps.text: Season One. The winner holds up the trophy. It's him. The Previous Winner is the Host.

f17_finale.name: Series Finale
f17_finale.desc: The Studio is open. Live audience. One take.

f17_runnerup.name: Runner-Up
f17_runnerup.desc: Last season's runner-up almost won. He's glad he didn't.

steps.label: Hear him out, the hard way

stairs.how: There is nothing below this. Choose.

f18_gate.name: The Wardens' Gate
f18_gate.desc: The Maintainers keep the Stack running. The Warden decides who sees what they maintain.

f18_echo.name: The First Contestant
f18_echo.desc: In the Echo Hall, the first contestant ever is still talking. Everything he says comes back a hundred times.

steps.label: Hear the First Contestant out, or silence him

f18_door.name: The Door
f18_door.desc: There is a door. There was always a door.

f18_ming.name: First Here
f18_ming.desc: Ming Zhao got to the bottom first.

steps.label: Find Ming
steps.text: She's sitting on an empty plinth. "There's no prize," she says. "There's just a chair."
